verdicts.reason: A has a sensible banner split: a well-sized bottle on the left, with logo, headline, body and CTA stacked in a left-aligned column. However, the brand circles are shrunk to tiny decorative dots, 'fizz' is left alone on its own line, and the bottle is crowded against the left edge. B keeps the large circles, but the bottle is shrunk until it is a minor element. The CTA is oversized, sits almost on the bottom edge and runs into the yellow circle, the body copy has a ragged right alignment, and the headline also leaves 'fizz' alone on its own line.
